status: Flags checked against `omp --help` (omp 18.8.3); event patterns are an UNVERIFIED starting point. The shape of `omp -p --mode json` events is not documented in Buracle's research; these patterns only assume that skill reads use skill://<id> URLs and MCP tools are named mcp__<server>_<tool>. Inspect the smoke-run stdout and rewrite the patterns before trusting any result.
usage: Per arm: --env HOME=<arm>/home --env PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR=<arm>/home/.omp/agent plus provider credentials. omp reads ~/.agents (skills and rules) by default, so the moved HOME hides the real ones. Build a without-arm with --append-arg --no-skills or --append-arg --skills=<glob>. Never add --auto-approve.

grader.status: Judge run limited to read tools (--tools). Smoke-graded on omp 18.10.1 against a local fake chat-completions endpoint (a models.yml provider, pinned with --append-arg --model): the request offered exactly read, grep and glob, and the answer was read from the JSON events. The quality of a real model's judgment is not covered by that smoke.
